title: Decomposition into directional influences
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $J$ be a set of coordinates. Its coalitional influence on $J$ equals the sum of its coalitional influences toward $1$ and toward $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
